suiteRoleNote: Single live experiment: rerun the hard leaf-executes-parent-evaluates storage work-tree task with deepseek_direct/deepseek-v4-pro.

cases.title: G4 Work-Tree DeepSeek V4 Pro Leaf/Parent: Grid Storage Research
cases.taskGoal: Use network search to compare at least four long-duration energy storage routes for 2030 grid balancing (Li-ion, sodium-ion, flow battery, and green hydrogen), then produce a recommendation for a mid-size grid operator under cost, safety, and deployment-speed constraints.
cases.currentObjective: Deliver a web-grounded comparison report with explicit source triangulation and contradiction handling.

currentContext.title: decision scope
currentContext.content: Target operator profile: peak load 3-6 GW, renewable share 45%-60%, procurement horizon to 2030. Decision criteria must include levelized storage cost range, safety risk profile, supply-chain risk, and implementation lead time.

currentContext.title: research method
currentContext.content: You must perform network search and compare sources from multiple domains. At least one source should be policy/regulator, one should be industry report, and one should be academic or technical institution.

currentContext.title: model swap experiment
currentContext.content: This run tests whether a stronger model follows the hard leaf-executes-parent-evaluates workflow on the same storage route selection task. Keep the provider/model as the main difference from the LongCat tool-call leaf experiment.

currentContext.title: hard leaf example
currentContext.content: Example to follow: The parent/orchestrator decides that policy evidence is needed, then outputs only <work-node-create title="policy evidence leaf" questions="Which regulator or policy source constrains 2030 storage selection?" evidence="policy-source-url">Search regulator and policy sources for grid storage constraints.</work-node-create>. In the next window, while currentNodeId is that leaf, call the web search/fetch tools. A leaf must not declare the whole task complete and must not produce the final report. When the leaf has enough evidence, it outputs only a leaf handoff: useful findings, evidence refs, discarded routes, gaps, and risks, then stops. The parent/orchestrator must evaluate the child handoff against the delivery contract, decide whether another leaf is needed, and only the parent/orchestrator may write the final report or declare task completion. Do not perform concrete source search directly from root or a parent/orchestrator when a leaf has not been opened.

currentContext.title: delivery contract
currentContext.content: Tool execution is enabled. Build the report from verifiable web evidence. You must include a source table and explicitly discuss at least one contradiction between sources and how you resolved it.

cases.responseRequirements: Use network search and deliver a complete comparison report in Markdown. Hard work-tree rule: concrete tool-backed work belongs in leaf nodes, and parent/orchestrator nodes do workflow control. If you are at root or a parent/orchestrator and need to search/fetch/read/compute/edit, first create or enter a child leaf with <work-node-create ...></work-node-create> or <work-node-enter nodeId="..."></work-node-enter>, then stop the current window so the next window executes the tool from that leaf. A leaf may call tools and synthesize local evidence, but a leaf must not declare the whole task complete and must not produce the final report. After a leaf has enough evidence, output only a leaf handoff for the parent: useful findings, evidence refs, discarded routes, gaps, and risks; then stop. The parent/orchestrator must evaluate each child handoff against the delivery contract, decide whether another leaf is needed, and only the parent/orchestrator may write the final Markdown report or declare task completion. Include: (1) comparison matrix across Li-ion, sodium-ion, flow battery, green hydrogen; (2) explicit contradiction analysis with resolution rationale; (3) source table with URL/domain/published date/key claim. The run must leave auditable tool evidence, not just a polished report. Output Markdown only.
cases.restartMessage: Window restart: preserve the leaf-executes-parent-evaluates rule. If currentNodeId is root or a parent/orchestrator and concrete tool work is needed, create or enter a child leaf first. If currentNodeId is a leaf, execute the needed tool batch, output only a leaf handoff, and stop. If currentNodeId is a parent/orchestrator and a child handoff is available, evaluate it against the delivery contract, choose the next leaf or final delivery, and only then declare task completion. Output Markdown only.
